Current budget: 30 uA tail, 120 uA second stage, so gm7~1.2 mS and p2>2.5*GBW. Rz cancels the RHP zero. The long-L tail gives CMRR >80 dB. A large-area L=1 input pair keeps flicker noise low. PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input pair L (noise area, gain)
    "Itail": (30e-6, 15e-6, 60e-6),  # first-stage tail current
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),      # PMOS mirror / 2nd-stage gm/Id
    "Lp":    (0.8, 0.4, 1.5),        # PMOS mirror + M7 length (shared -> zero systematic offset)
    "I7":    (120e-6, 60e-6, 250e-6),# second-stage current
    "Ln":    (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),        # NMOS current-source length (tail, M8, bias)
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 2e-12),
    "kRz":   (1.6, 0.8, 3.5),        # Rz = kRz / gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = It / 2
    gmid_n = 8.0

    # devices
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.2)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=m1.vgs if False else 0.75)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["kRz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: ibias sunk by diode nfet
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # input pair: vinp drives the output-side device -> non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # PMOS mirror load (diode on the vinn side)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage: PMOS CS + NMOS current source
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * cl + Cc * (C1 + cl)))
    zr = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / gm7)) if Rz > 1.0 / gm7 else -1e18
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / zr)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg))))
    cmrr_db = db(A1 * 2 * m3.gm / m5.gds)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(2 * 4 * kT * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise_1k = noise_th * 4.0     # rough flicker allowance at 1 kHz
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.7)
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I7)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db,
               "noise_1k": noise_1k, "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "power": power}
